messages:
maria: quick check — are we good to kick the canary for nova-3b-open? need license + perf profile in catalog before launch next Tue. owners: @sam (perf/artifacts) + @jess (manifest/licensing).

sam: I ran perf on staging quantized artifact earlier. median ~98ms, p95 ~145ms on p4d, batch=1. I still have a tokenization mismatch for rerank tests. not a blocker for latency but CI failing.

jess: legal flagged attribution/notice in the manifest; otherwise license looks fine (Apache-2 compatible). @legal can confirm exact wording we need.

legal: legal: quick note — Apache-2 is OK, but add SOURCE_URL + upstream attribution in model manifest and verify no export controls. once that's in I can sign off.

owen: infra: I can provision a 3-node canary pool (dedicated small) but need the artifact path mounted at /mnt/models/nova-3b/quant and the KV cache warm-up script. give me the path + ETA and I’ll spin it up.

maria: @owen pls go ahead once artifact available. @sam can you upload to staging and ping CI for the smoke run? also need perf profile doc (p50/p95/p99) in catalog metadata.

sam: uploading now — link: s3://staging-models/nova-3b/quant_v2.tar.gz. kicking off validation.

ci-bot: ci-bot: validation started for nova-3b-open (job 4821). running smoke + rerank integration.

ci-bot: ci-bot: smoke tests PASS (median 98ms, p95 145ms, p99 210ms). integration: rerank fails with tokenizer shape mismatch. log snippet: `ValueError: Expected input_ids shape (batch, seq) got (batch, seq+1)`

sam: looks like HF tokenizer token count differs (special tokens mapping). I'll reproduce locally and push a mapping fix. prob caused by HF tokenizer v0.20 differences.

jess: tokenizer for this model is HF v0.20, yes. add mapping in manifest: `tokenizer: hf/v0.20`, and include special_tokens_map. I’ll draft the manifest change.

maria: cool. action items: 1) @sam upload tokenizer-mapped artifact (today EOD), 2) @owen provision canary pool & KV warm (in progress once artifact), 3) @legal finalize manifest wording (SOURCE_URL + attribution), 4) @jess update catalog perf profile with p50/p95/p99 and quick notes on batch/baseline. canary target: 10% traffic tomorrow 10:00 PT.

sam: noted — will push fix and ping ci-bot.

owen: provisioning queued, will update when nodes ready. estimated ready in ~3h after artifact appears.

jess: I’ll update manifest and add licensing blurb. will attach a short checklist for intake so launch ops can verify.

maria: perfect. if we clear tokenization + legal by EOD we can run a final smoke at 9am PT tomorrow and flip canary at 10. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: devops-bot: reminder — don’t forget to add monitor runbook entry for nova-3b canary (latency thresholds, error budget alert).

maria: good catch. @owen can you create the runbook stubs?

owen: yup will add runbook and alert thresholds after pool is up.

maria: thanks everyone — ping here once CI passes with new artifact and legal signs off.

sam: will do.

jess: leaving checklist draft in the catalog PR now.
